notes.title: Everglow 1.3.3 migration update hotfix
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed missing Steam libs, which prevents getting achievements in Steam.
[*] Fixed missing legacy 00_ and rpyc files, which prevent a smooth upgrade from the old version to the new one.
[/list]

notes.title: Everglow 1.3 aka "Definitive edition"
notes.content:
Everglow was released one year ago! Happy birthday, Glow!

[list]
[*] Language selector now available on first boot.
[*] Engine updated to RenPy 8.
[*] Grammatical and logical errors swept out from Russian text.
[*] Endings russian voice over by [url=https://vk.com/natasha.belkina]Natasha Belkina[/url] added.
[*] Endings english voice over by Sarah Collier re-done from scratch.
[*] English translation re-done from scratch.
[*] Glow “thinking” indicator added to clearly distinct from regular speech.
[*] Assets cleanup performed.
[*] Transitions with text now wait for interaction, instead of fading out after x seconds.
[*] Some jarred characters transitions were fixed to be more clear.
[*] One missing background added related to the F R I E N D fate (faded cactus).
[*] Achievements images re-shuffled correctly.
[*] Sound and voice test added to settings.
[*] Mac and Linux versions no longer try to output Glow work terminal email to the screen.
[/list]

P.S. Thanks [url=https://twitter.com/ryou_saito]Saito Ryou[/url] for 1.3 update cover art

notes.title: Spring is here!
notes.content:
Spring is here, and we are out of hibernation too.

We hope that everybody is safe and sound.

This little announcement is just to remind you that we have an [url=https://aristarhys.github.io/]official website[/url], on which we post monthly updates.

For example, recently, the first pages of our scriptwriter's webcomic was released at [url=https://aristarhys.github.io/sonata]his page[/url], and its are free to check out.

We have multiple projects in various stages of production, which are covered in these updates.
So, checking it once in a while would be really nice.
